adjudication.rationale: The diff makes `TopicEmbed.import` depend on `EmbeddableHost.record_for_host(url)` to choose a category (`category: eh.try(:category_id)`), which can be `nil` when no matching row exists. The migration `CreateEmbeddableHosts` inserts legacy `embeddable_hosts` values verbatim via raw SQL (`VALUES ('#{h}', ...)`), bypassing the model’s `before_validation` normalization that strips `http://`, `https://`, and paths. Since `record_for_host` parses the URL and matches on `where("lower(host) = ?", uri.host)`, rows stored as `http://example.com`/`https://example.com/123` will not match `uri.host` (`example.com`), producing `eh == nil` and thus no selected category. Whether this results in uncategorized/public exposure via downstream logic isn’t shown in the diff, but the nil-category + bad migration normalization is a concrete, diff-grounded behavioral defect.
